description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of Zero-Shot performance across different difficulty levels – easy, medium, and hard – categorized by knowledge types. The chart consists of three pie charts, one for each difficulty level, and a total of four categories represented by color: teal (N+K+), orange (N-K+), coral (N-K-), and red (N+K-). In the “easy” chart, the teal slice represents 55.4%, the orange slice 38.3%, and the coral slice 4.6%; percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The “medium” chart shows teal at 58.8%, orange at 35.4%, coral at 4.8%, and red at 6.7%, also with internal percentage labels. Finally, the “hard” chart displays teal at 37.3%, orange at 37.9%, red at 6.7%, and coral at 4.8%, again with internal percentage labels. A legend is provided to the right of the charts, mapping colors to knowledge types. The slices within each pie chart appear to be ordered clockwise from largest to smallest proportion.
